name: salt-phase-down-mjs
description: The OBBBA SALT cap phase-down: married filing jointly, MAGI $575,000, SALT paid $45,000. The $40,000 cap is reduced by 30% of the $75,000 MAGI excess over $500,000, to $17,500 - the exact worked example Fidelity publishes, and the Schedule A State and Local Taxes Worksheet line by line.

source.publication: Instructions for Schedule A (Form 1040) (2025), State and Local Taxes Worksheet lines 5-10; cross-check: Fidelity 'What is the SALT deduction?' (same numbers)
source.pin: Schedule A worksheet verbatim: line 5 'Enter $500,000 ($250,000 if married filing separately)'; line 7 'Multiply line 6 by 30% (0.30)'; line 8 'Subtract line 7 from line 1' (line 1 = $40,000 cap); line 9 'Enter the larger of the amount on line 8 or $10,000'. Fidelity cross-check: 'multiply that $75,000 overage by 30%... to get $22,500. Then subtract $22,500 [from $40,000]' = $17,500.

derivation: Wages $575,000 = MAGI; SALT paid = 30,000 state income tax + 15,000 real estate = $45,000; itemizing elected.
